content.short: Pika Protocol is a perpetual swapping protocol with up to 100x leverage.
content.description: Pika Protocol is a DeFi platform that enables up to 100x leverage on trades. Users can swap tokens directly from their wallets without depositing. Operating on layer-2 networks lowers gas costs versus Ethereum mainnet, and the protocol is available across multiple networks including OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, Ethereum, Base, and BNB Chain. Although focused on crypto trading, Pika expands beyond Web3 by incorporating non-Web3 assets, broadening its asset reach beyond traditional DeFi tokens.
